crime: At eleven, walking home arm in arm with her best friend along the canal, {WITCH_NAME} told her she had pictured pushing her in. The friend let go, crossed the street, and never walked with her again. Once people knew what she thought, they let go of her arm.

A girl who could never sit through an evening took her arm and walked the upper railing with her every night, the first arm in hers since the canal. One evening she confided she sometimes pictured tipping the girl over the railing. The girl laughed, slipped her arm free and crossed to the wall side. "Then you take the railing side." After that she walked beside her every evening, never arm in arm.
With her Magic, {WITCH_NAME} kept the feel of that arm slipping from hers on her elbow. She walked on, elbow crooked round nothing.

On film night, as the lights in the recreation room went down for the projector, she put her arm round a prisoner who always asked for one at films. Meanwhile the girl from the railing walked it alone while everyone else watched the screen. {WITCH_NAME} answered the arm that had slipped from hers: from behind, she hooked her crooked arm round the girl's neck and held on until she was still. Leaving the film, the prisoners found her dead against the railing; they had passed her walking there on their way in.

In the trial court, the girl from film night swore the arm had lain round her from lights down to lights up, with {WITCH_NAME} beside her when it lifted. The others pointed to her cardigan: worn at lights down, shrugged off as the room grew warm, in her lap at lights up. It had come off her shoulders from under an arm that never lifted. They saw it then: {WITCH_NAME} had slipped her real arm out, leaving the girl only its kept touch, then slipped it back.
fields.epitaph: She never left my side. All I kept was the arm she took back.
fields.epithet: Keeper of the Arm That Let Go
execution: The execution stand rises as a canal lock, and she is chained upright where its two timber gates meet. The long balance beams swing out, and the gates open away from her. Then the beams swing back. The gates swing shut and close on her from either side. They stand shut and still, her crooked elbow caught in the seam.

magic.name: Lingering Touch
magic.text: She can make any touch she gives or receives linger on the skin after the hand has gone.
